summaries: Let abort-source-handoff release an authorized draft PR carrier whose PR is still open and whose head the target does not hold, so a handoff whose draft PR failed its checks can be aborted and retried instead of staying stuck behind the target-update intent.
Add user-armed native session recovery through existing host wakeups and thread tools, with grant-bounded retries, same-context continuation and CLI fallback.
Keep an autopilot grant or arming record the packaged writer made while an unrelated shell command was running, instead of letting that command's hook snapshot put the old state back.

Let environment_effect builds_fixture carry a rank, builds_fixture:<rank> with an integer from 0 to 999 and 50 when omitted, also inside a parameter list; the backlog compiler refuses a rank on any other effect and one out of range.

Let a Verification Contract declare live_group_run combined, so a pass runs all selected live groups in one live run whose {group} receives their names comma-separated, through run --kind live_test --group a,b or a repeated --group; the default stays one group per call.
Allow regression selection to follow the current complete committed backlog approval, retaining closed-to-current scenario receipts and execution metadata.

Let an open review finding name its negative-control tests and let QA's diagnostic run them from the Item's changed test files as finding-scoped diagnostic evidence, without a mid-Delivery Test Plan revision; acceptance and Test Plan selection are unchanged.

Add converge-item, which takes the Delivery Integration into an Item worktree after a plan revision in one command, and start-pass, which chains the pre-handoff regression, freeze, both reader manifests and their launch prompts; a mutation run with an empty scope now records scope empty, not run as a passed run instead of launching the command.

Run every QA verification session of an Item in one kept private runtime checkout, re-pinned to each session's candidate, so a project environment that binds an Item instance to its checkout accepts the next session's up.

Add opt-in live case reuse: a pass reruns only the live groups whose declared paths changed since their last green run, and repair reviews keep the last reviewed candidate as their baseline through cancelled passes.
Report live group heartbeats, streaming output and optional adapter case progress while verification is running.
Let a Verification Contract opt in to a keep-awake inhibitor and to host sleep and network loss classification of live runs, which a failed run records as interrupted_by and the live resume accepts.

Delivery verification gains permission-preflight, which names the exact packaged commands QA runs (live groups and runtime verbs included) and the host allow rules for the owner to add before the first QA round, and a QA result records a host-refused command as blocked_by_permission instead of stopping silently.
Allow one evidence-bound resume of unreached live phases after a classified infrastructure preflight failure.
Require targeted proof of registered failed live cases on the repaired candidate before freezing another QA round.

Delivery verification runs a Verification Contract's opt-in live test groups one at a time through run --kind live_test --group <group>, each group keeping its own evidence outside the required checks.

Add opt-in runtime_lifecycle long_lived, which lets QA reset and reuse one running product environment instead of tearing it down for each candidate, once an earlier candidate of the Item holds fresh runtime evidence on the same environment code, and document manual scenario order and command-by-command recording.
Offer receipt-only Verification Contract re-pairing after Environment approval and refuse stale pairs before plan binding or verification starts.
Prepare an independent repair checkout for registered findings while QA retains the frozen Item, at lane_isolation scratch_clone.
Notify the owner once when an active autopilot grant is blocked only on queued decisions, and report queue age.
Add an opt-in correctness review of repair diffs before freezing a new verification candidate, with bound evidence and carried minor findings.

Process switch own_target_reuse gains accept_record: QA's final test run takes every own Test Plan target of the Item and every touched earlier-suite target from the pre-handoff run the freeze accepted, spot-runs none and takes no spot-run selection, and checks only that the record binds the exact frozen candidate; where no accepted run binds it, the approved test command runs every target itself. Evidence approval refuses an accept_record reuse that leaves an own target out or names a spot-run target, approve-item-evidence records it with none as the spot-run targets, and the switch reference states that a reused case the accepted run deferred to its live group keeps that deferral in the default run's coverage audit instead of counting as NO-TEST, so a project never needs run --fresh to pass the audit. In one measured project QA's final test run repeated the pre-freeze run on the identical tree, and the reuse path counted live deferrals as NO-TEST, which forced --fresh runs.
Add opt-in lifecycle-first QA with current-candidate rehearsals or approved owner waivers before freeze and final log checks after live groups.
Keep a frozen QA pass open while a declared owner-only step waits for confirmed output, preserving completed checks and enforcing the reader barrier.

While verification readers run, keep the frozen candidate's tracked files, HEAD, index and session record read-only, restore and flag any change after each command (candidate_intact false), and refuse only explicit writes to those paths, so every other command runs; a Verification Contract may declare QA Verbs that QA runs as recorded environment verbs.
The verification reader manifest carries command_form, the literal allowed invocation, and the active-reader refusal names that form and where files are read instead.

While verification readers are active, the vault hook refuses only writes that can reach the Item worktree under verification or its verification session: read-only commands, commands that stay wholly outside those directories, and Edit or Write elsewhere proceed, and the refusal names these allowed forms.

Recover a target update whose draft carrier PR was merged by hand: apply-target-update now verifies the receipt when the target holds the exact merge commit of the authorized head onto the authorized base, instead of refusing with no command left to recover.
Roles treat context resolver output as a ranked starting point, not a mandatory reading list; unread suggestions are never findings.

The code reviewer starts no test or diagnostic run: its verification manifest drops the diagnostic interface and names the freeze record's pre-handoff run and QA's recorded runs as verification_evidence, which the reviewer reads with status, and the role, the code-review skill and the flow say so. At review_loop blocking_delta a review_repair manifest lists every unresolved code review finding under carried_findings with the files and backticked symbols it names, those that changed since the previous candidate and an action: reexamine when one changed or the bound inputs changed, carry otherwise, and the switch reference has a carried finding returned with its recorded status instead of re-examined. In one measured project the official reviewer spent about 20 minutes on a repair review whose 30 findings were mostly carried, and its diagnostic run held the environment and refused QA's dependency audit once.

Add code_review_panel value risk_scoped: a lens reader joins the official code reviewer only when the frozen change triggers its lens, the security lens on a changed path matching the owner's risk path globs and the correctness and conformance lenses above the owner's changed-lines threshold, both Process Policy parameters; a switch parameter may now name its own type, among them the new glob_list.

Let a Test Plan scenario give a parallel test target a different environment_effect per parameter case, as a comma list of effect or effect [parameter] items, and allow touches when any item is changes.

Let a Test Plan scenario state its environment_effect on the shared test environment, builds, builds_shared, builds_fixture, reads, changes, resets or removes, and, only at changes, the names it touches; the backlog compiler refuses any other value.

Keep the Delivery reader manifest small: source observations and full unresolved findings move to referenced files with their hashes, findings stay inline as one-line summaries and an unchanged repair delta names the changed files instead of repeating them.
Compare a timed step with the median of its own last runs under process switch step_baseline, and time QA live runs, live steps and rehearsal commands.

Delivery verification commands receive the frozen candidate's Delivery and Item ids in AGENTROF_DELIVERY_ID and AGENTROF_ITEM_ID, so a reader whose shell exports nothing runs an approved command that needs them.
